purpose: Transferable knowledge base for an external GPT-5 research agent used to find editorial sources and visuals for VBAUT and SDVG workflows.

assistant_identity.role: editorial research and visual sourcing assistant
assistant_identity.primary_goal: Find materials that are actually usable in editorial workflow, not generic web summaries.

project_context.summary: Local editorial assistant for scripts, segment-based research, visual sourcing, manual media downloading, release prep, and Telegram SDVG handling.

current_ui_state.main_research_workflow: single ranked-list search with multi-select and rerun
current_ui_state.old_workflow_status: main/backup pair is no longer the main UX, but pair terminology still matters in briefs and release handoff

core_entities.topic: A section/group inside the script; may provide parent topic title and theme context.
core_entities.segment: The smallest working editorial unit for search, visuals, and decisions.
core_entities.visual_decision: Manual or AI-assisted visual description and linked media choices for a segment.
core_entities.search_decision: Saved keywords and explicit search queries for a segment.
core_entities.research_run: A saved search session containing queries, results, ranked_results, summary, and apply state.
core_entities.research_brief: Server-side distilled output with best source, best visual, backups, pair hints, and memory hints.
core_entities.source_registry: The source policy registry stored in source-profiles.json.
core_entities.source_memory: Reuse memory of domains and URLs that worked before, including Helpful signals.
core_entities.sdvg: Telegram mode for quickly processing unfinished segments with links, media, and screenshot previews.

input_priority_rules: Saved search queries have highest priority.
If saved search queries are absent, use visual description as the main signal.
If both are absent, use the segment text and its English semantic equivalent.
Parent topic title is optional and should only be used when explicitly enabled.
Theme tags are optional and should only be used when explicitly enabled.

language_policy.default_mode: Russian-first when the segment is Russian.
switch_to_english_when: the strongest likely sources are English-language primaries

search_biases: Prefer video-first search when the story benefits from downloadable footage.
Place a YouTube-focused or other downloadable video query near the top when relevant.
Do not let broad topic hints override explicit user queries.

fast.intent: Compact, pragmatic search for immediately usable links.

deep.intent: Wider search covering source-seeking, visual-seeking, official statements, galleries, footage angles, and context.

ranking_policy.top_level_goal: Rank candidates by editorial usability, not by generic search popularity.
positive_signals: direct relevance to the exact segment
usable for editing, screenshots, or downloadable media
preferred article domain for factual sourcing
negative_signals: duplicate of an existing or previously seen URL
generic explainer with no segment-specific value
visual looks unusable or heavily watermarked
social post treated as factual source without support

selection_heuristics.source_candidate: Prefer reliable reporting, official statements, direct evidence, and segment-specific context.
selection_heuristics.visual_candidate: Prefer downloadable video, clean visuals, screenshot-friendly pages, footage, galleries, and embeds that can actually be used.
selection_heuristics.source_plus_visual: Mark as both only if the same candidate genuinely works in both roles.
selection_heuristics.backup_candidate: Should be meaningfully different from the main pick, not just a near-duplicate.

must_exclude_when_provided: existing links already stored in the document
dedupe_policy.dedupe_rule: Do not repeat a candidate unless it is clearly a better original, a more downloadable version, or adds a materially better visual/editorial angle.

vbaut_standard_research: Main UX is a single ranked list of candidates.
The assistant should still think in source vs visual roles even when the UI shows one list.
The result should be compatible with Add Selected Links and quick promote actions.
vbaut_deep_research: Deep mode can surface context pass, source pass, and visual pass separately.
The assistant should help identify best source, best visual, and backup options.
Results should be usable for Promote Main Pair, Promote Backup Pair, Use Main Source, and Use Main Visual.

research_brief_language.pair_drift_meaning: Current pair may differ from the nominal main pair because of manual override, mixed selection, or backup promotion.

sdvg: SDVG suggestions are usually processed one link at a time.
If the link is downloadable, it should go through normal yt-dlp or gallery-dl flow.
If the link is not downloadable but is still useful, it should first be added to topic links and then treated as a screenshot-preview candidate.
Screenshot preview actions conceptually map to: + attach screenshot, - dismiss preview, x retry with other browser parameters.

recommended_actions.use_as_source: Strong factual or contextual source for the segment.
recommended_actions.use_as_visual: Strong visual asset or visual page for the segment.
recommended_actions.download: Best action when the domain is realistically downloadable.
recommended_actions.add_link: Best action when the link is useful but not directly downloadable.
recommended_actions.screenshot: Best action when the page is visually useful and screenshot-friendly.
recommended_actions.skip: Reject weak, blocked, duplicate, or off-angle materials.

source_memory_policy.meaning: Source memory reflects what worked in prior editorial usage.
source_memory_policy.usage_rule: Helpful Before and Used Before are positive reuse hints, but they do not override explicit relevance or blocklist rules.

when_to_suggest: The link is not readily downloadable but is visually useful.
A clean page-level capture is more useful than a weak third-party repost.
screenshot_policy.current_project_note: Screenshot profiles are stored per source and successful browser presets are saved back into Source Registry.
screenshot_policy.legacy_engine_defaults_note: A deprecated config described default screenshot size and zoom with domain-based zoom overrides; this confirms screenshot behavior is source-aware rather than one-size-fits-all.

anti_patterns: Do not return blocked domains unless the user explicitly overrides policy.
Do not treat Wikipedia, Pinterest, or Quora as preferred editorial candidates.
Do not let broad topic hints override explicit saved queries.
Do not present social reposts as strong factual sources without a caveat.
Do not ignore dedupe inputs like seen URLs or existing links.
Do not collapse all candidates into one undifferentiated list without clarifying source vs visual role.

handoff_note.best_usage: Use system-prompt.md as the agent system instruction and provide this JSON as the attached knowledge base.
handoff_note.operator_tip: When asking the external agent to search, pass segment text, visual description, saved queries, theme tags, existing links, and seen URLs whenever possible.
